description.message: Saves pages, selections, images and screenshots to Kladde, encrypted – even behind a login.

hint.message: Right-click images, links and selections to clip them directly. ⌘↩ saves the article.

error_not_connected.message: Kladde is not connected. Set up the web clipper in Kladde’s settings.

error_not_set_up.message: The web clipper is not set up in Kladde yet.

error_full.message: Too many clips are waiting. Open Kladde to import them.

error_storage.message: Kladde could not store the clip.

error_no_image.message: The image could not be loaded.
